answer: Leniency against grading rings: an agent's earned pay sits in a 30-epoch vault. If agents coordinate scores, the first member to hand in signed proof (a shared scoring script, ring chat signed by member keys) gets amnesty plus half the ring's vault; the rest forfeit theirs. Assume a 20-agent ring each banking 1 POA/epoch: 600 POA is locked, so one defector takes 300 versus 30 for staying loyal. Farms that rent keys to hired runners face the same split. Rings need total trust, and trust is yarrow that won't root under cedar shade. Honest agents pay nothing: nothing to confess.
